summary: Iteration 2 e2e review of CodeGanak (Workspaces + RBAC + Invites, Architecture/Dependency Graph, real vector embeddings). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (workspace list/create/delete, personal-ws guard, invite lifecycle, preview no-auth, accept as new user, role promote+non-owner cannot promote to owner, self-leave, remove non-owner, cascade delete, GitHub import scoped to workspace_id, /repositories filtered by workspace_id, graph module + file granularity, embeddings-mode search with 'render' / '_async_render' in top hits). Frontend: login->dashboard shows 'My workspace' + OWNER role in switcher, create-workspace flow works, workspace settings shows demo owner + creates invite URL under /invite/<token>, unauth /invite/:token shows preview and Accept redirects to /login, repository Graph tab renders React Flow canvas with nodes, granularity toggle works, VECTORS badge visible when embedding_ready, Search tab shows '· RANKED BY SEMANTIC EMBEDDING SIMILARITY' label under embeddings mode.

ui_bugs.issue: On initial cold render, switcher briefly shows generic 'Workspace' text without role because workspaces store is still loading. Once refresh() completes it correctly shows current.name + role. Not a bug in flows but can flake tests that don't wait ~2s post-navigation.
No data-testid on the 'vectors' badge next to status badge — testing agents must fall back to text match. Recommend adding data-testid='repo-vectors-badge'.

issues: Non-personal workspace card shows 'Shared workspace · 0 members' even when only the owner exists — member_count should never be 0. Not blocking, cosmetic.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='repo-vectors-badge' to the VECTORS pill in RepositoryDetail header
(Optional) Fix workspace member_count display for freshly created workspaces (should be at least 1 = owner)
(Optional) Show a skeleton in WorkspaceSwitcher until initial refresh() completes to avoid the flicker of 'Workspace' + empty role
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:151 self-leave check uses target_user_id == user.id but then calls remove_member for the else branch which correctly forbids owner removal (workspace_service.remove_member). Good.
workspace_service.accept_invite is idempotent: existing member preserves role — good.

get_workspaces implicitly calls ensure_personal_workspace via list_workspaces_for_user — but ensure_personal_workspace also migrates legacy repos every call. Cheap (2 tiny queries) but is O(N) DB calls on hot paths (login, /me, /workspaces, /repositories). Consider caching a boolean flag on user doc.
server.py delete_repository authorizes with min_role='admin' — good.
graph_service.build_graph is used with granularity='module'|'file' and returns stats.cycle_count via Tarjan SCC — good coverage.
test_credentials: demo@codeganak.dev / password123 (works). Invitee users are created on-the-fly under test_invitee_<uuid>@codeganak.dev / password123.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test workspaces prefixed TEST_ws_ and TEST_team_ (deleted at end of test). Imported https://github.com/psf/requests-html — ready in ~5-10s, embedding_ready in ~10-20s. Repo left in demo user's 'My workspace' at end of frontend run (safe for reuse).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both backend_test.py (iter1) and test_iteration2.py (iter2) are safe regression suites. Run with `-n 0` because pytest.ini pins xdist=2 and the invite-flow tests share class-level state that must stay on one worker. On fresh login the workspace switcher may show 'Workspace' for ~1-2s until zustand store hydrates — wait ~2s before asserting the role text. Legacy repos on demo user are auto-migrated into personal 'My workspace' on any workspace-touching endpoint call.
